text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Economic and Community Development Committee under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office starting January 5, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Elected Councillor Mark Grimes as Vice Chair of the Economic and Community Development Committee for a term of office starting January 5, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022.
